metaTitle: How to Layer Clothing for Camping
description: Build a camping layering system with a wicking base, an insulating mid-layer and a shell, plus how to adjust on the move and keep hands and feet warm.
directAnswer: Use a moisture-wicking base layer, an insulating mid-layer and a weatherproof shell, and adjust often so you stay just below sweating. Avoid cotton, start cool, and keep a warm puffy ready for camp.
